whatIs: useAnimations is a collection of 300 animated line icons, each with its own interaction: they play on hover, on click or in a loop. You use them as a React component with the react-useanimations package, add them with the shadcn/ui CLI, or download them as Lottie JSON and SVG.
It's a good fit when you want micro-interactions on buttons and menus without drawing or animating the icons yourself.
uses: Animate the heart on a "like" button or a menu icon that turns into a close icon on click.
Show a looping loading icon inside a button while a form is being submitted.
Bring the same icons to a mobile app using the Lottie files.
caveats: The react-useanimations package is React-only; in other environments you use the Lottie JSON files or the static SVGs.
Lottie files need a separate player, such as lottie-web or lottie-android; the React package, on the other hand, ships with its own 8 kB one.
They're line icons with a style of their own: check that they match the rest of the icons in your interface.
pricingNote: Free under the MIT license, commercial use allowed and attribution optional.
idealFor: Interfaces that want ready-to-use icons with micro-animations.
